text.title: Single Page Case Study Generation — Decision Tree
text.summary: Routing tree mapping observable engagement signals (defensible number, days since delivery, client permission, evidence and quote captured) to a rule from `01-core-rules.xml`. Every leaf references a rule id.

decision-tree.root-question: Is there at least one quantitative outcome with a baseline and a final value readable from a system the freelancer can export (Stripe, logs, GA4, calendar, P&L)?

conclusion.verdict: no measurable outcome to stand behind; log the engagement in one line and do not write a study on adjectives

branch.question: Is the engagement delivered and paid within the last 30 days?

conclusion.verdict: log as missed; do not apply retroactively, add the 7-day draft task to the next delivery checklist

branch.question: Has the client agreed in writing to a named study, or to an anonymised one (industry, size band, context, quoted role)?

conclusion.verdict: offer the anonymised version explicitly before giving up; only a written refusal of both moves the engagement to the internal log

branch.question: Are the evidence exports stored and is a verbatim quote with written publish consent captured?

conclusion.verdict: collect the export and the one-sentence quote with consent before drafting; both must be stored with the artefact
draft the six slots on one page with an outcome-first title and one tracked CTA within 7 days; publish or park within 14

text.example: defensible_number=true -> within_window=true -> permission=named_or_anonymised -> evidence_and_quote=true -> conclusion ref=run-the-checklist
